memory_candidates.content: When /orchestrate dispatches two implementations concurrently with directory-level territory assignments, intersect each plan's per-phase 'Files to modify' list against the assigned territory before dispatching. A module-path rename task's import-rewrite set routinely reaches outside the directory being renamed, so a territory drawn around the renamed directory alone will block the task's central phase.

A subagent that escalates to its dispatching orchestrator mid-dispatch can deadlock: the orchestrator is typically blocked awaiting that subagent's completion, so it never reaches a tool round to read the message. Escalation to a busy parent must therefore be paired with a self-resolving default (close the current phase, mark the blocked one, return partial) rather than treated as a request that will be answered in-flight.

Adding one sibling aggregator .lean file under a directory that carries a generated inventory block turns INV red in three places at once in BimodalLogic: the directory's own README, FormalSystem/README.md, and the root README.md totals block. Regenerate with `scripts/check-module-invariants.sh --emit-inventory` as part of the same change rather than treating it as a separate defect.
